editorial:
Imagine you are a hardworking doctor just trying to do your job, and suddenly your ambulance crashes right into a river. That is exactly how your journey begins in this strange and moody drama. You get to follow a man who wakes up in a world that feels off, where he cannot quite figure out if he is dreaming or if something much darker is happening to him. The vibe is very mysterious and a bit creepy, making you feel as lost as the main character is while he tries to piece together where he is and why this happened.

What really works here is the acting, which makes the confusion feel real. While the story moves a bit slow at times, the twists keep you guessing until the very end. If you love movies that make you think and question reality, you will really dig this one. It looks great in high definition, so you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video if you can. If you prefer owning your movies, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is a smart move for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: You eventually find out that the doctor is actually dead. The strange world he has been wandering through is a kind of limbo or afterlife. The crash in the river was fatal, and the mysterious events were his mind trying to accept that he is gone. In the final scenes, he finally lets go of his earthly worries and finds peace, moving on from the living world once he understands the truth about his accident.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty stories about life and death.
